example.en: Routine component servicing prevents unexpected mechanical power generator failure.
example.zh: 例行性的零組件保養可防止發電機發生意料之外的機械動力故障停擺。

words.mnemonic: fail (失敗、故障) + -ure (名詞尾) ＝ 機械故障 (equipment failure) 或未履約。

example.en: Dr. Vance will serve as the keynote guest speaker at tomorrow's healthcare industry conference.
example.zh: 范斯博士將擔任明天醫療保健產業高峰大會的主題演講貴賓。

words.mnemonic: speak (說) + -er (人/物) ＝ 演講貴賓 (keynote speaker) 或音響設備。

example.en: Automating logistical processes will significantly improve our company's ultimate bottom line.
example.zh: 自動化物流流程將顯著改善我們公司的最終財務底線盈虧狀況。

words.mnemonic: 商業必考成語：the bottom line (帳目底線、最終利潤損益)。

example.en: The board of directors resolved to adopt more environmentally sustainable manufacturing policies.
example.zh: 董事會決議採納施行更具環境永續性的製造生產政策。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + opt (選擇) ＝ 選中並納為己用 ＝ 採納、採用新方針。

example.en: The upcoming corporate merger will combine two of the nation's largest logistics distribution firms.
example.zh: 即將進行的企業合併將把全國最大的兩家物流倉儲發貨公司合而為一。

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + bin (雙、兩者) ＝ 將兩者綁在一起 ＝ 結合、合併。

example.en: The alpine luxury mountain resort offers corporate retreat packages with conference rooms.
example.zh: 這間高山奢華度假勝地提供附帶專用會議室的企業共識營套裝行程。

words.mnemonic: 旅遊與度假村考題：mountain view (山景客房)、mountain resort。

example.en: Lean factory production methodologies help assembly plants reduce material waste significantly.
example.zh: 精實工廠生產管理手法有助於組裝廠大幅減少材料浪費與耗損。

words.mnemonic: 環保與成本控制：reduce waste (減少浪費)、waste management (廢棄物管理)。

example.en: Our transparent business billing pricing model ensures there are no hidden surprise fees.
example.zh: 我們公開透明的商業定價模式確保絕無任何隱藏的意外附加費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與帳單極高頻：no hidden fees / hidden charges (無隱藏收費)。

example.en: The modern architecture design showcases a harmonious marriage of functionality and aesthetic appeal.
example.zh: 這座現代建築設計展現了實用機能性與美學吸引力的完美和諧結合。

words.mnemonic: 商務比喻常用：a marriage of A and B (A與B的完美結合/聯姻)。

example.en: Please submit an electronic IT support ticket to request assistance with network access.
example.zh: 請提交電子技術支援報修單，以申請網路存取障礙的排除協助。

words.mnemonic: 交通車票或 IT 支援報修單：round-trip ticket (來回票)、support ticket (報修單)。

example.en: Complimentary gourmet hot meals and beverages are served on all international flights.
example.zh: 所有國際長途航班均免費供應精緻熱食餐點與各類飲品。

words.mnemonic: 餐飲服務核心字：complimentary meal (免費招待餐點)、meal voucher (餐券)。

example.en: I will consult my senior colleagues in the legal department before replying to the proposal.
example.zh: 在回覆該企劃案之前，我會先諮詢法務部門的資深同事們。

words.mnemonic: col- (共同) + leg (挑選、代表) ＝ 共同被選在一起共事的人 ＝ 同事、同僚。

example.en: Passengers are allowed to bring one carry-on bag and one personal item on board.
example.zh: 旅客獲准攜帶一件手提登機行李袋以及一件個人隨身物品登機。

words.mnemonic: 機場航空必考：carry-on bag (手提隨身行李袋)、baggage (行李總稱)。

example.en: Our boutique hotel loyalty program rewards repeat guests with complimentary room upgrades.
example.zh: 我們精品飯店的會員忠誠回饋計畫為常客回頭客提供免費客房升等的禮遇。

words.mnemonic: 商業極重要搭配：repeat customer / repeat business (回頭客、再度光顧)。

example.en: Our firm is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity.
example.zh: 本公司很榮幸成為致力於推動多元包容職場的公平就業機會雇主。

words.mnemonic: 招聘政策必考條款：equal opportunity employer (均等就業機會雇主)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee submitted a formal written expression of interest in the project.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會對該合作專案正式提交了書面表達意願書 (EOI)。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + press (擠壓、按) + -ion ＝ 傳達表達出來；expression of interest (意向表達)。

example.en: The conference registration price is four hundred dollars plus applicable regional sales tax.
example.zh: 會議報名費為四百美元，外加適用的該地區消費營業稅。

words.mnemonic: 報價常用介系詞：price plus tax (價格外加稅金)；名詞指一大優勢 (a big plus)。

example.en: Senior management was extremely pleased with the outstanding marketing campaign results.
example.zh: 高階管理層對於本次行銷活動所展現的傑出亮眼成果感到極度欣慰滿意。

words.mnemonic: extreme (極端的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 非常極其 (extremely helpful)。

example.en: The commercial building owner agreed to renovate the lobby entrance and elevators.
example.zh: 這座商辦大樓的業主同意全面重新整修一樓迎賓大廳與電梯設備。

words.mnemonic: own (擁有) + -er (人) ＝ 房東業主或企業主 (business owner)。

example.en: Passengers will board the chartered cargo plane as soon as pre-flight checks are finished.
example.zh: 飛航前安全檢查一旦順利完成，搭機旅客便將隨即登上這架包機貨機。

words.mnemonic: 搭機登機常見：board a plane (登上飛機)、cargo plane (貨運機)。

example.en: The master of ceremonies welcomed ladies and gentlemen to the annual awards banquet.
example.zh: 大會司儀盛情歡迎各位女士與先生蒞臨這場年度頒獎表揚晚宴。

words.mnemonic: 大會致詞禮貌開場：ladies and gentlemen (各位女士、各位先生)。

example.en: International travelers must declare all purchased retail goods subject to customs duty.
example.zh: 跨國入境旅客必須申報所有依法須課徵關稅的已購零售商品。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：job duties (工作職責) 或 duty-free shop (免稅商店)。

example.en: Our corporate SWOT strategic audit highlighted our regional customer loyalty strength.
example.zh: 我們的企業 SWOT 戰略分析審查突顯了我們在區域客戶忠誠度方面的強大優勢。

words.mnemonic: 商業分析核心：strengths and weaknesses (優勢與劣勢)。

example.en: The high-speed rail line directly connects the international airport to downtown financial offices.
example.zh: 該高鐵路線將國際機場與市中心金融商業辦公區直接緊密串連起來。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + nect (綁定、連結) ＝ 相互串聯 ＝ 連線、接駁 (connect to)。

example.en: Global management seminars train team leaders in overcoming cross-cultural communication challenges.
example.zh: 跨國管理研討會旨在培訓團隊領導者克服跨文化溝通協調中的挑戰。

words.mnemonic: culture (文化) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 跨文化 (cross-cultural)。

example.en: The corporate event planner will arrange hotel accommodations for visiting international delegations.
example.zh: 企業活動籌劃專員將為造訪的國際代表團安排預約飯店客房住宿。

words.mnemonic: 商務秘書排程必備：arrange a meeting (安排開會)、make arrangements。

example.en: Human resources introduced a competitive employee retirement pension savings scheme.
example.zh: 人力資源部推行了一項極具市場競爭力的員工退休年金儲蓄保障方案。

words.mnemonic: 英式商務常考指「正式規劃方案」：pension scheme (退休金方案)、incentive scheme。

example.en: Please remit electronic invoice payment via direct wire transfer within thirty business days.
example.zh: 請於三十個工作日內透過直接銀行電匯支付電子發票款項。

words.mnemonic: pay (支付) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 繳費支付 (make a payment)。

example.en: Unfortunately, all standard banquet conference rooms are fully booked for that weekend.
example.zh: 很遺憾地，該週末所有標準宴會會議室皆已被全數預約客滿。

words.mnemonic: 客服婉拒常用開頭詞：un- (不) + fortune (幸運) + -ate + -ly ＝ 遺憾抱歉的是。

example.en: The director will deliver a brief introductory presentation on upcoming product specifications.
example.zh: 處長將就即將推出的產品規格進行一段簡短的開場說明簡報。

words.mnemonic: 商務會談核心詞：brief presentation (簡要簡報)、brief someone on (向某人簡報)。

example.en: Attendees who register before next Friday qualify for an early bird discount rate.
example.zh: 在下週五前完成報名的與會者即可享有早鳥優惠折扣價。

words.mnemonic: 行銷促銷與報名必考：early bird discount (早鳥特惠優惠)。

example.en: A field engineer will demonstrate the new laser cutting machinery to prospective buyers.
example.zh: 現場工程師將親自向潛在採購客戶實機示範操作這台新款雷射切割機械。

words.mnemonic: de- (完全) + monstr (展示、顯示) + -ate ＝ 完整操作給人看 ＝ 示範 (demonstrate how to)。

example.en: The newly hired interns will undergo intensive safety orientation over the next week.
example.zh: 新聘實習生將在接下來的一週接受密集的安全到職訓練。

words.mnemonic: 時程規劃基礎詞：twice a week (每週兩次)、next week (下週)。

example.en: Effective communication plays an essential role in fostering cross-departmental collaboration.
example.zh: 有效的溝通在促進跨部門合作中扮演著至關重要的角色。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場閱讀極高頻片語：play an important role in (在...中扮演要角)。

example.en: The company introduced a flexible policy that allows staff to work from home on Fridays.
example.zh: 公司推出了一項彈性政策，允許員工在週五居家辦公。

words.mnemonic: 遠距辦公現代多益必考：work from home (WFH, 在家上班)。

example.en: Workers should never operate hazardous machinery without wearing the proper protective goggles.
example.zh: 工人在未配戴適當防護護目鏡的情況下，絕不得操作危險機具。

words.mnemonic: 安全規章與禁令強調用語：should never do (絕不應當做某事)。

example.en: The room rate includes complimentary high-speed internet access and daily breakfast.
example.zh: 房費包含免費高速網路連線與每日早餐。

words.mnemonic: 合約與費用明細核心字：tax included (含稅)、include breakfast (附早餐)。
roots: clud 關閉 → 關進去、包含

example.en: Employees who complete the online project management course will receive a recognized certificate.
example.zh: 完成線上專案管理課程的員工將獲得認可的結業證書。

words.mnemonic: 在職訓練常用詞：training course (培訓課程)；of course (當然)。

example.en: Our creative department handles all graphic design in-house rather than hiring an external agency.
example.zh: 我們的創意部門在內部自行處理所有平面設計，而非外聘外部機構。

words.mnemonic: 商務極高頻片語：in-house (公司內部自行處理的)。

example.en: The financial analyst finalized the quarterly earnings report ahead of the board meeting.
example.zh: 財務分析師在董事會會議前完成了季度盈餘報告。

words.mnemonic: 職場最核心名詞/動詞：financial report (財報)、report to (向主管回報)。
roots: port 攜帶 → 帶回消息

example.en: Senior management will convene next Tuesday to review the corporate expansion roadmap.
example.zh: 高階管理層將於下週二召開會議，以審議企業擴張藍圖。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sen- (年長、老) + -ior (較...) ＝ 年資較深、職級較高的 (senior manager)。

example.en: Please attach a recent digital passport-style photo to your employee ID application.
example.zh: 請在您的員工識別證申請表上附上一張近期的數位證件照。

reviewWords.mnemonic: photograph 的口語簡寫：photo ID (附照片的身分證件)。

example.en: The supplier refused to accept return packages without prior authorization codes.
example.zh: 供應商拒絕接收未附帶事先授權碼的退貨包裹。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + fuse (流、倒) ＝ 倒流回去不收 ＝ 拒絕接受 (refuse to accept)。

example.en: Public transport connections between the international airport and downtown are excellent.
example.zh: 國際機場與市中心之間的大眾運輸交通連結十分便捷優質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: trans- (跨越) + port (攜帶、搬運) ＝ 跨區運送 ＝ 運輸物流。

example.en: Renewable energy has emerged as a major sector for sustainable corporate investment.
example.zh: 再生能源已崛起浮現成為企業永續投資的主要關鍵產業領域。

reviewWords.mnemonic: e- (出) + merge (浸入、沒入) ＝ 從水中浮出 ＝ 嶄露頭角、浮現。

example.en: The conference registration packet includes a color campus facility map.
example.zh: 大會報到資料袋內附有一份彩色會場園區設施地圖。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 地圖；動詞片語 map out (周詳規劃藍圖)。

example.en: Design engineers introduced an eco-friendly concept car at the automotive exposition.
example.zh: 設計工程師在國際車展上展示發表了一款環保概念車。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + cept (拿取、抓住) ＝ 在腦海中共同抓住的構想 ＝ 概念。

example.en: The luxury resort hotel is located on a private tropical island accessible by boat.
example.zh: 這間奢華度假飯店座落於一座私人的熱帶島嶼上，需搭乘渡輪接駁抵達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 注意字母 s 不發音 (/ˈaɪlənd/)；商場展售常見 display island。

example.en: The financial services board initiated regulatory reforms to enhance market transparency.
example.zh: 金融監理委員會發起法規改革，以提升整體市場透明度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (再) + form (成形) ＝ 重新塑造成更好的形狀 ＝ 改革。

example.en: Neither the project director nor the lead engineer could attend today's symposium.
example.zh: 專案主管與首席工程師兩位今天都無法出席研討會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法題高頻必考：neither A nor B (A和B兩者皆不是)。

example.en: Our marketing firm purchased prime television commercial slots during the championship football game.
example.zh: 我們的行銷公司在美式足球冠軍賽轉播期間買下了黃金電視廣告時段。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 廣告贊助常考：football stadium (球場)、commercial sponsor (贊助商)。

example.en: Few independent retail shops survived the prolonged regional economic downturn.
example.zh: 極少數獨立零售商能在這場持久的區域經濟低迷中維持營運生存下來。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + viv (生命、生活) ＝ 在苦難之上活下來 ＝ 生存、度過難關。

example.en: Passengers are requested to arrive two hours before their scheduled flight departure time.
example.zh: 請旅客於預定航班起飛時間前兩小時抵達機場航廈辦理登機手續。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益機場必考：flight attendant (空服員)、connecting flight (轉機航班)。

meaning: 剩下的(leave 的過去分詞)

example.en: Turn left past the security checkpoint to locate boarding gates twelve through twenty.
example.zh: 穿過安檢站後請向左轉，即可找到十二號至二十號登機門。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 方向指引：turn left (左轉)；庫存剩餘：two units left (剩下兩件)。

example.en: Our technical support team worked diligently to solve the customer's network issue.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援團隊克盡職責迅速解決了客戶的網路連線障礙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞 solution (解決方案)；solve a problem (解決問題)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters invited commercial neighbors to an open house community preview.
example.zh: 企業總部邀請周邊鄰近的商戶夥伴參加開放日社區預覽會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 衍生詞 neighborhood (鄰里街區、周邊周遭)。

example.en: The candidate has an impressive academic and professional background in corporate finance.
example.zh: 該應徵者在企業財務領域具備令人印象深刻的亮眼學歷與專業工作背景。

reviewWords.mnemonic: back (後方) + ground (地面、根基) ＝ 身後的累積資歷 ＝ 背景。

example.en: Staff members will attend a training workshop to master modern project management techniques.
example.zh: 員工將參加培訓工作坊，以熟練掌握現代專案管理技巧。

reviewWords.mnemonic: techn- (技能、工藝) + -ique (名詞尾) ＝ 具體的操作技巧技術。

example.en: The corporate website redesign resulted in a forty percent increase in monthly web traffic.
example.zh: 企業網站的重新改版讓每月的網路造訪流量大幅增加了百分之四十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：公路車潮 (heavy traffic) 或網站訪客量 (website traffic)。

example.en: Staff suggestions led to significant improvements in warehouse inventory workflow safety.
example.zh: 員工的提案建議促使倉儲庫存工作流程的安全防護獲得了顯著的改善。

reviewWords.mnemonic: improve (改善) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 改善措施、進步。

example.en: Our digital project management tool enables seamless real-time team collaboration.
example.zh: 我們的數位專案管理軟體工具實現了流暢無間的即時團隊協作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 實體工具或數位應用工具：analytical tool (分析工具)、software tool (軟體工具)。

example.en: Failing to fulfill safety compliance regulations may carry severe legal consequences.
example.zh: 未能嚴格履行安全法規標準可能將承擔嚴重的法律後果。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + sequ (跟隨) + -ence ＝ 隨之而來的後續結果 ＝ 後果。

example.en: Under no circumstances should confidential customer data be disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
example.zh: 在任何情況下，均嚴格不得將機密客戶資料外洩給未經授權的第三方。

reviewWords.mnemonic: circum- (環繞) + st (站立) + -ance ＝ 環繞在周圍的客觀局勢 ＝ 情況。

example.en: The corporate building policy strictly prohibits employees from smoking on the premises.
example.zh: 企業辦公大樓規章嚴格禁止員工在大樓場所範圍內吸菸。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店與安全警報必備：smoke detector (煙霧偵測警報器)、non-smoking room (禁菸房)。

example.en: Initial consumer market reaction to the newly launched beverage line has been overwhelmingly positive.
example.zh: 消費者市場對這款新上市飲品系列的初期反響呈現壓倒性的正面好評。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + act (行動) + -ion ＝ 對外界刺激做出的反向動作 ＝ 反應。

example.en: The outdoor company summer picnic was relocated to the auditorium due to forecasted heavy rain.
example.zh: 由於天氣預報指出將有大雨，公司夏季戶外野餐活動已改至大禮堂舉行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益天氣與活動延期考點：heavy rain (大雨)、rain date (雨天延期備案日期)。

example.en: The customer service hotline was unusually busy following the release of the software update.
example.zh: 在軟體更新版發布之後，客戶服務專線異常繁忙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 繁忙期：busy season (旺季)、busy line (電話佔線通話中)。

example.en: The corporate retreat offered valuable lessons in crisis mitigation and effective team communication.
example.zh: 這場企業共識營為危機化解與高效團隊溝通提供了寶貴的經驗教訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益培訓與檢討：lessons learned (學習到的經驗教訓)。

example.en: The creative advertising department will brainstorm marketing strategies for the holiday campaign.

reviewWords.mnemonic: 趨勢與潮湧：wave of innovation (創新浪潮)、heat wave (熱浪)。

example.en: The regional distribution logistics terminal is located ten kilometers south of the airport.
example.zh: 該區域物流集散航廈位於機場以南約十公里處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 方位導引與出差位置：south of (在...之南)、South America (南美洲)。

example.en: Automation technology investments significantly reduced manufacturing factory operational labor costs.
example.zh: 自動化技術的投資顯著降低了工廠生產製造中的營運勞動人力成本。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資與生產核心字彙：labor cost (勞工成本)、skilled labor (熟練勞工)。

example.en: Inspectors verified that the titanium component surface was completely free of scratches.
example.zh: 檢驗人員核實了該鈦金屬零件表面完全沒有任何刮痕瑕疵。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + face (面) ＝ 最上面那一層 ＝ 表面 (surface mail 地面陸運)。

example.en: Employees can access the corporate digital training video library through the internal intranet.
example.zh: 全體員工可透過企業內部網路隨時查閱公司的數位培訓影音資源庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: libr- (書本) + -ary (場所) ＝ 圖書室，商務上常指數位資料檔案庫 (digital library)。

example.en: The newly recruited marketing specialist demonstrated an excellent command of corporate public relations.
example.zh: 新招募的行銷專員展現了對企業公共關係處理的極其出色的掌控能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cel (超越) + -ent ＝ 出類拔萃的 ＝ 優秀的 (excellent service)。

example.en: Proprietary automated manufacturing processes give our firm a distinct competitive edge.
example.zh: 專利的自動化製造工藝為我們公司帶來了顯著的市場競爭優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：competitive edge (競爭優勢)、have an edge over (勝過)。

example.en: New technical recruits attend an intensive two-week software engineering training boot camp.
example.zh: 新進技術人員需參加為期兩週的密集軟體工程培訓訓練營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工職前培訓常見搭配：training camp / boot camp (培訓訓練營)。

example.en: The commercial marketing presentation was tailored specifically to appeal to our target corporate audience.
example.zh: 這場商務行銷簡報經過專門量身規劃，以精準吸引我們的企業目標受眾族群。

reviewWords.mnemonic: audi- (聽) + -ence (名詞) ＝ 聆聽的受眾群 ＝ 聽眾、目標受眾 (target audience)。

example.en: The regulatory commerce committee officially voted to lift export trade restrictions on semiconductors.
example.zh: 商務監管委員會正式投票通過解除對半導體產品的出口貿易限制。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：lift restrictions (解除限制禁令) 或英式電梯 (take the lift)。

example.en: Please send a confirmation email with the signed non-disclosure agreement attached.
example.zh: 請發送一封隨附已簽署保密合約的確認電子郵件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: e (electronic) + mail ＝ 電子郵件 (confirmation email)。

example.en: Our international enterprise logistics network serves global corporate clients across five continents.
example.zh: 我們的跨國企業物流網路為橫跨五大洲的全球企業客戶提供優質服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: globe (地球) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 全球性的 (global economy / market)。

example.en: Small retail shops often struggle to compete against large multinational discount e-commerce chains.
example.zh: 小型零售門市在與大型跨國平價電子商務連鎖集團競爭時往往苦苦苦苦支撐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業困境常用：struggle to compete (艱困競爭)、struggle to survive (掙扎求存)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department will advertise the vacant engineering position online.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部將在網路上刊登招聘該出缺工程師職位的公開徵才廣告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + vert (轉向) ＝ 把大眾注意力轉移過來 ＝ 登廣告 (advertise a position)。

example.en: There is little doubt that the proposed budget reductions will impact marketing activities.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，擬定之預算縮減將會對行銷推廣活動產生影響。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀常見修飾不可數名詞表否定 (little doubt 毫無疑問)；a little 表少量。

example.en: Our technical support hotline is open twenty-four hours a day to help registered users.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援專線全天候二十四小時開放，隨時為註冊用戶提供協助。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服宗旨用語：help someone with something (協助某人某事)；help desk (諮詢台)。

example.en: Attendees are warmly encouraged to ask questions at the conclusion of the workshop.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎與會人員在工作坊結束時踴躍提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 問答環節必備動詞：ask questions (提問)；ask for approval (請求核准)。

example.en: Our latest batch of electronic components meets all strict industrial quality standards.
example.zh: 我們最新一批電子零組件符合所有嚴格的工業品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最經典考點！meet 除了見面，更常考「符合/滿足」：meet standards, meet deadlines。

example.en: The orientation program for newly recruited employees will start promptly at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 新進員工到職培訓計畫將於上午九點整準時開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議、專案或機具啟動的核心動詞：start a project (啟動專案)。

example.en: The human resources manager arranged a session to talk about employee benefits and healthcare.
example.zh: 人力資源經理安排了一場說明會，以討論員工福利與健保制度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商談必備動詞：talk about (討論某事)、talk with (與某人交談)。

example.en: If you notice something wrong with your online billing statement, notify customer service at once.
example.zh: 若您發現線上對帳單有任何異常之處，請立即通知客戶服務部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶問題反饋常用句型：something wrong (有異常/出問題)。

example.en: Management decided to put together a special committee to oversee the office relocation.
example.zh: 管理層決定籌組一個專責委員會來督導辦公室搬遷事宜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務片語高頻考點：put together (組建/彙整)、put off (延期)。
